name: MonarchStatusDot
title: StatusDot
summary: A small coloured dot followed by a text label, such as "Running" or "Paused", in five tones and two sizes.
whenToUse: For the live state of an item in a list, a table or a header: a service that is running, a person who is online, a job that is deploying.
whenNotToUse: For a label with a filled background use MonarchBadge. For a message about a whole screen or section use MonarchBanner.
api: @Composable fun MonarchStatusDot(label: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Neutral, size: MonarchStatusDotSize = MonarchStatusDotSize.Sm, pulsing: Boolean = false, labelHidden: Boolean = false)

options.name: label
options.description: The words for the status. Always required, so color is never the only signal.

options.name: tone
options.description: Neutral, Info, Success, Warning or Danger.

options.name: size
options.description: Sm: an 8dp dot with caption text. Md: a 10dp dot with label-sized text.

options.name: pulsing
options.description: Draws a ring that grows from the dot and fades, for something live or in progress.

options.name: labelHidden
options.description: Draws only the dot and keeps the label for TalkBack.

states.name: default
states.description: A dot in the tone color and the label in the default text color.

states.name: pulsing
states.description: A ring of the dot color grows to 2.4 times the dot and fades, every 1.6 seconds. Not drawn when animations are off.

states.name: label hidden
states.description: Only the dot is drawn; TalkBack still reads the label.

appearance: The dot uses the solid color of the tone; the neutral dot uses the subtle text color. The label uses the default text color. The same roles are used in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web StatusDot also has an accent tone; MonarchTone has no accent, so Android offers five tones, as iOS does. The web hides the label with a visually hidden class; Android does not draw it and sets it as the content description. The parameter names follow Android: pulsing and labelHidden for the iOS isPulsing and isLabelHidden. The pulse fades with the alpha of the drawing, as the web animates opacity; no color role is dimmed. The label wraps instead of being ellipsized as on the web, so it is never cut at a large font size.
accessibility: The dot and the label are one TalkBack element, read as the label.
The dot and the pulse are decoration; the meaning is in the words.
With labelHidden the label is the content description of the element.
The pulse is not drawn when the user has turned animations off.
The dot and the text grow with the font size setting.
Not interactive, so it has no touch target.
edgeCases: A long label wraps beside the dot; the dot stays centered on the text.
With labelHidden the sighted user sees only a color: add a visible legend nearby.
The pulse ring is drawn outside the bounds of the dot and is not clipped; leave room around a pulsing dot.

examples.title: Tones
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space2)) {
    MonarchStatusDot(label = {{items.0.label}}, tone = {{items.0.tone|tone}})
    MonarchStatusDot(label = {{items.1.label}}, tone = {{items.1.tone|tone}})
    MonarchStatusDot(label = {{items.2.label}}, tone = {{items.2.tone|tone}})
    MonarchStatusDot(label = {{items.3.label}}, tone = {{items.3.tone|tone}})
    MonarchStatusDot(label = {{items.4.label}}, tone = {{items.4.tone|tone}})
    MonarchStatusDot(label = {{items.5.label}}, tone = {{items.5.tone|tone}})
}
examples.code:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space2)) {
    MonarchStatusDot(label = "Draft", tone = MonarchTone.Neutral)
    MonarchStatusDot(label = "Scheduled", tone = MonarchTone.Info)
    MonarchStatusDot(label = "Running", tone = MonarchTone.Success)
    MonarchStatusDot(label = "Paused", tone = MonarchTone.Warning)
    MonarchStatusDot(label = "Failed", tone = MonarchTone.Danger)
    MonarchStatusDot(label = "Featured", tone = MonarchTone.Accent)
}

examples.title: A live state that pulses
examples.code: MonarchStatusDot(label = "Recording", tone = MonarchTone.Danger, size = MonarchStatusDotSize.Md, pulsing = true)
